column1: # Hornvale sub-floor roster (The Staff). One test id per line.
# Every test measured strictly below BASELINE_FLOOR_SECS on the
# canonical gating host's last full-workspace run. NOT host-keyed:
# a test's identity does not vary by machine even though its
# duration does, and the commit gate runs on machines (the Macs)
# that never author a roster of their own -- see `subfloor_path`'s
# doc in windows/lab/src/timings.rs for the full reasoning.
# The commit gate (`make gate-commit`) runs exactly these.
# Rewritten by the chamber's `gate` phase on every GREEN chamber job (a
# stage gate or a merge, `scripts/sluice-run.sh`); a red run leaves it
# alone, because a red run's `run.json` is truncated and a roster taken
# from one would silently DROP tests from the commit gate. `make
# gate-stage` used to be named here and is a refusing signpost now
# A test absent from this file is NOT in the commit gate — see the
# spec's exclude-unknown rule. It enters on the next green chamber job.
